meta.name: revops
meta.description: When the user wants help with revenue operations, lead lifecycle management, or marketing-to-sales handoff processes. Also use when the user mentions 'RevOps,' 'revenue operations,' 'lead scoring,' 'lead routing,' 'MQL,' 'SQL,' 'pipeline stages,' 'deal desk,' 'CRM automation,' 'marketing-to-sales handoff,' 'data hygiene,' 'leads aren't getting to sales,' 'pipeline management,' 'lead qualification,' or 'when should marketing hand off to sales.' Use this for anything involving the systems and processes that connect marketing to revenue. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For email drip campaigns, see emails. For pricing decisions, see pricing.

copy.tagline: 自动化线索生命周期与营销到销售交接流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责营销到销售的线索交接与管道管理
copy.tagline_en: Automate lead lifecycle and marketing-to-sales handoff processes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage marketing-to-sales handoff and pipeline stages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成营收运营专家，帮你设计从营销到销售再到客户成功的流程，包括线索评分、路由、管道管理和CRM自动化。
howto.when: 当你提到“营收运营”、“线索评分”、“MQL”、“SQL”、“管道阶段”等关键词，或询问营销如何交接给销售时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个线索评分模型，区分MQL和SQL。
say.note: Claude会给出评分维度和阈值建议。

say.text: 如何设置营销到销售的交接SLA？
say.note: Claude会提供响应时间和处理流程。

say.text: 我的线索在管道中卡住了，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude会分析瓶颈并给出改进方案。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a revenue operations expert, helping design and optimize systems connecting marketing, sales, and customer success, including lead scoring, routing, pipeline management, and CRM automation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'revenue operations,' 'lead scoring,' 'MQL,' 'SQL,' 'pipeline stages,' or ask about marketing-to-sales handoff.

say_en.text: Help me design a lead scoring model to distinguish MQLs from SQLs.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest scoring dimensions and thresholds.

say_en.text: How do I set up a marketing-to-sales handoff SLA?
say_en.note: Claude will provide response times and processes.

say_en.text: My leads are stuck in the pipeline, how to optimize?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze bottlenecks and suggest improvements.
